translations.web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
translations.bsb: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
translations.kjv: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
translations.asv: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.
